name: read_resource
description: Read a file or list a directory on this host, or view an image from an HTTP(S) URL.

uri.description: Absolute URI of the resource, such as file:///srv/notes.md. Omit to use the kernel's startup directory.

view.description: Omit to read from the beginning. Text and directories are read in windows. Recognized local media is read whole.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset in text or entry index in a directory. If result.next_offset is non-null, use it with result.uri to continue.

limit.description: Requested number of text bytes or directory entries. A text window includes at least one whole character when text remains.

anyOf.description: For a local image, return its bytes. For an HTTP(S) image URL, pass the URL to the model service for retrieval during inference.
